overall_notes: This paper primarily focuses on reducing modality gaps in vision-language models and proposes I0TScore as an improved automatic evaluation metric for image captioning. The paper uses human judgments for correlation analysis but doesn't conduct extensive human evaluations of generated outputs. The extraction was generally accurate but needed normalization of naming conventions and addition of comparison models.
